hook: Put computer parts on the desk and watch each one's power: the screen lights up, the keyboard types, the speakers sing. Then give the computer jobs, and find the part Nibbles the mouse unplugged.
outcome: Name common computer parts and what each one does, match parts to jobs, and describe what goes wrong when a part is missing
